parameters: \bI get so excited imagining what kinds\nof Pokémon I'll get to see in the next\nContest. The anticipation of it thrills!
\bI'm bored, you see.\nYou may entertain me.
\bPerhaps I shall get Father to acquire\na yacht for me.\nA yacht for me and Pokémon!
\rOh, you're such an adorable Trainer.\nWould you like to have tea?\nOr would you rather battle?
\rA world cruise on a luxury liner has its\ncharms, I must say…
\rBut, I will admit there is an appealing\nside to touring Hoenn by ferry.
\bTo be never ruffled in any situation is\nthe gentleman's code of conduct.
\bFriends need not be human.\nFor me, Pokémon are treasured friends!
Usually you could also watch out the portholes,
or walk a certain number of steps, to move
the ferry along its route. Currently, only
There's a bed…\nLet's take a rest.
\bWe have made land in \v[97].\nThank you for sailing with us.
\rLea: I wanted to battle…\nBut you don't even have two Pokémon…
\rLea: I feel a little silly, but…\nWe'll show you our lovey-dovey power!

\rLea: I can't believe it!\nOur lovey-dovey power failed…\nYou must be an awesome Trainer!
